name: Lucas County, OH
findings: Lucas County has 1,744 nonprofit organizations. 680 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 556 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (18% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Lucas County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Political organizations stand out for volunteering
observations.text: 17 political organizations here list volunteering, compared with about 6 in similar places of this size.
